facts: Parties: Kingsmere Marine Ltd (Buyer), Eskdale Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Redcliffe Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 17 May 2027; Closing is scheduled for 25 August 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 17 May 2027), either party may terminate.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $6,750,000. The Purchase Price is $75,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,380,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $73,760,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 14 September 2027.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
